paper.title_en: Semiclassical spectrum of the Ising CFT
paper.abstract_en: We develop a semiclassical framework to determine scaling dimensions of neutral composite operators in scalar conformal field theories. For the critical Ising <math display="inline"><mi>λ</mi><msup><mi>ϕ</mi><mn>4</mn></msup></math> theory in <math display="inline"><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>ε</mi></math>, we obtain the full spectrum of composite operators built out of <math display="inline"><mi>n</mi></math> fields transforming according to the various Lorentz representations to next-to-leading order in the double-scaling limit <math display="inline"><mi>n</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mi>∞</mi></math> and <math display="inline"><mi>λ</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mn>0</mn></math> with <math display="inline"><mi>λ</mi><mi>n</mi></math> fixed. At any given order, the semiclassical expansion resums an infinite number of Feynman diagrams. Combining our results with existing perturbative computations further yields the complete five-loop scaling dimensions in the <math display="inline"><mi>ε</mi></math>-expansion for the family of <math display="inline"><msup><mi>ϕ</mi><mi>n</mi></msup></math> operators. Finally, extrapolating the semiclassical results to three dimensions leads to a competitive alternative to existing methodologies.
